comment: Sevii quest chain, beat 6 (completion): delivering the Sapphire and the Network Machine coming online (pokefirered EventScript_GiveCelioSapphire). Source order: the hand-over (give_item sapphire -1 rides the op's own arithmetic), his thanks, the machine checks, the Lanette link, and his closing thanks. The fanfare hand-over message (Text_HandedSapphireToCelio) is not a say step; the item step IS that moment. Completion effect, mirroring the source's SetPostgameFlags at this exact point: sevii_network_machine_complete is set - the flag build 6 wires to the stitch/region layer as this quest's completion record (the source here sets FLAG_SYS_CAN_LINK_WITH_RS and FLAG_HIDE_CERULEAN_CAVE_GUARD; the cave-guard cross-reference is carried in data/fixed_encounters.json's Mewtwo record). After this script, Celio's repeat talk is Text_WishYouBestOfLuck (source scene 6) - ordinary NPC dialogue, not part of this script.
